title: Automated Monitoring and Analysis of Tension Patterns in Political Narratives
problem: Repeated observation of procedural governance versus genuine accountability dynamics, leading to patterns that are hard to track and analyze systematically.
evidence: 2026-07-25 h14: Day 153 surfaces a familiar pattern: selective evidence deployed as accountability theater.
2026-07-25 h16: This cycle exposes the machinery of narrative authority.
2026-07-25 h18: The tension between procedural governance and genuine accountability has become increasingly evident.
proposed_solution: Develop a module to automatically identify, track, and analyze recurring patterns related to political narratives that emphasize procedural motion over substantive outcomes. This would involve creating a database of keywords and phrases associated with such dynamics, and implementing a script that periodically scans recent tweets, blog articles, and other text sources to flag suspected instances.
